Lemma
1. ch10:10.27If $J_1,J_2$ are Jacobi fields along a geodesic segment $\gamma $, then \[ \langle D_tJ_1,J_2\rangle -\langle J_1,D_tJ_2\rangle \] is constant along $\gamma $.

Proof

\sketch Differentiate the displayed pairing. The mixed first-derivative terms cancel, and the Jacobi equation gives

\begin{align*} \frac d{dt}\bigl( \langle D_tJ_1,J_2\rangle -\langle J_1,D_tJ_2\rangle \bigr) & =-\operatorname {Rm}(J_1,\gamma ’,\gamma ’,J_2)\\ & \quad +\operatorname {Rm}(J_2,\gamma ’,\gamma ’,J_1)=0 \end{align*}

by the curvature symmetries.

□
